title: In this town, every footprint glows until sunrise
premise: In this town every footprint glows in its owner's colour until the next sunrise. Back in my grandmother's orchard for harvest week, my old pink paths still glow in every row, though everyone else's prints fade at dawn. Each dawn a new trail of huge square prints that do not glow runs beside my path and ends a little nearer the house, where something built from far too few blocks stands still all day.
twist: My prints never faded by themselves. Every night since I left, Nan has walked my old paths step for step, inside my prints, so mine got one more night every night and hers never showed. The square trail was walking the empty place beside her, where a second walker used to be.
world: A small farm town at harvest week: a cobbled dusk street, a townsman's kitchen, and an apple orchard of seven long rows in fog behind a whitewashed farmhouse, with a bench at the end of the far row.
